idea_name: MLP pattern vector over consecutive bars for neural entry signal
mechanism: TeachHNN builds labeled BUY/SELL patterns as continuous bar sequences preceding profitable moves; CSignalHNN FillPattern/CalculateHNN feeds the bar vector into an external multilayer perceptron and returns Direction in [-100,100] used against Signal_ThresholdOpen/Close.
data_needed: OHLC bars on chosen symbol/TF; optional graphical arrow labels or auto SignalsCreate with SignalsBarPoints/SignalsBarsCount windows; Hlaiman pipe for train/infer
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 (2010-01-01–2013-07-12) in tester report; any symbol/TF supported by TeachHNN
why_new_for_mis: Treats a fixed-length price-bar sequence as a graphical pattern sensor whose MLP output is a continuous direction score, not a classical indicator reading.
quote: we will deliberately confine ourselves to the concept of a neural network as a black box capable of associative thinking and predicting market entries based on recognition of graphical price patterns. For the same reason, we will use the simplest notion of the pattern being a continuous sequence of bars in a trading instrument chart that precedes a profitable price movement.

idea_name: Interactive RSS reader UI in MT5
mechanism: CRssReader CAppDialog loads RSS via WebRequest/EasyXML and displays channel/item titles in list/text controls; no market regime or price sensing.
why_new_for_mis: Full read shows UI/XML plumbing only; no sensing idea for MIS.
quote: We have completed the creation of an entirely interactive RSS Reader application for MetaTrader 5, using object-oriented programming techniques.

idea_name: Bar-return autocorrelation as volatility-immune regime filter for MA crossover
mechanism: ACF of Yi=(Close-Open) over CorrPer with LagPer; Trigger ACF at SMA crossover and Trade ACF while open; fixed ACF threshold filters SMA-cross entries; monthly ACF tracks eras where MAC is profitable. ATR/BB-spread monthly averages do not align with profit eras.
data_needed: M15 OHLC for Close-Open series; SMA fast/slow periods; CorrPer and LagPer
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD and GBPUSD M15, Jan 2006–Dec 2021; ACF indicator also shown on H1
why_new_for_mis: Separates autocorrelation of bar returns from volatility proxies (ATR, BB width) as a regime sensor that predicts when trend-following MAC works.
quote: Unlike the ATR and Bollinger Bands indicators, the AutoCorrelation Function (ACF) does not have a dependence on volatility. The ACF is a helpful tool to find patterns in time series data.

idea_name: Trade-vs-trigger ACF separation as change/regime health monitor
mechanism: Strategy Tester plots average Trade ACF separately for profit vs loss trades over time; large separation coincides with profitable MAC eras (e.g. 2008–2013 EURUSD); collapse of separation after ~2018 matches flat equity.
data_needed: Per-trade ACF on open trade window; labels of win/loss; SMA cross triggers
why_new_for_mis: Uses time-varying separation of in-trade vs pre-trigger ACF as a meta-sensor of when trend persistence is fading.
quote: Both charts show a time varying separation of the ACF between profit and loss trades. The profitable region 1/2008-6/2013 in Figure 1 (EURUSD) roughly matches a region in Figure 8 where the separation of the ACF is also large.

mechanism: Manager/assistant EA pool with custom events and RESOURCEDATA resources wraps blocking WebRequest into WebRequestAsync; infrastructure only.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: demo on EURUSD H1 / GBPJPY M5 charts
why_new_for_mis: Full read is concurrency plumbing for HTTP, not market sensing.
quote: it would be good to create a tool for asynchronous non-blocking execution of HTTP requests, a kind of WebRequestAsync.

idea_name: Kohonen SOM with U-Matrix short-path clustering as regime/topology sensor
mechanism: CSOM trains on normalized feature vectors; builds U-Matrix (mean distance to neighbors), hit counts, per-node MSE; Clusterize() sorts neurons by GetDistance()*sqrt(GetMSE()) and grows clusters along low U-distance neighborhoods (Korotky/short-path clustering) without pre-set K.
data_needed: CSV/set-file feature vectors (EA opt results or mixed indicators); CellsX/Y; EpochNumber; optional ValidationSetPercent
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: generic; SOM-Explorer EA; applied later to EA parameter sets / economic ranges (Part I tools)
why_new_for_mis: U-Matrix + QE-weighted adaptive clustering turns SOM into an unsupervised regime map of multi-feature market/parameter space.
quote: U-matrix is used to detect such areas. In it, the areas where there is a large difference between neuron weights and the weights of its neighbors appear as "peaks", while the areas where neurons are very similar look as "lowlands."

idea_name: Feature-wise z-score normalization before SOM learning
mechanism: InitNormalization computes per-component mean and sigma via one-pass formula; Normalize/Denormalize so mixed-scale features (profits vs Sharpe) all participate in topology learning.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit sensing precondition: without normalization SOM collapses to the largest-scale feature plane only.
quote: You should not teach a Kohonen network using such different-scale data, since the network would practically consider the larger components only and ignore the smaller ones.

idea_name: Modular EA with swappable CStrategy kernels
mechanism: CModule/CSnap/CTradeMod/CParam communicate only via CStrategy facade; SwitchStrategy swaps trend vs flat kernels at runtime—architecture, not sensing.
data_needed: none beyond OHLC for demo candle rule
why_new_for_mis: Software structure article; no new MIS sensor after full read.
quote: We have designed an Expert Advisor using elements of standard design patterns Observer and Facade.

mechanism: Video transcripts on OnTick, Comment, Strategy Tester, data types, if/switch/loops, custom functions—language tutorial.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AUDCAD M1 demo in tester examples
quote: MQL5 does not need to be complicated. I hope, this first part will help you get started

idea_name: MT5 install and autotrading setup video
mechanism: Download/install MT5, demo account, chart templates, Expert Advisors options, first Moving Average backtest—setup chrome.
quote: in this video you have learned how to set up MetaTrader 5 to work with automated MQL5 Expert Advisors.

idea_name: Butterworth low-pass filter on scaled closes before LSTM ONNX
mechanism: MinMaxScaler then butter_lowpass_filter(cutoff, order) on close series; train LSTM→ONNX; compare filtered vs unfiltered RMSE/R2 and Sharpe heatmaps; tuned cutoff=0.1 order=1 preferred.
data_needed: tick/H1/M30/M15/M5 EURUSD closes; SAMPLE_SIZE lookback for ONNX
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1/M30/M15/M5; Feb 2024 and longer windows; NextDay refresh periods D1/H12/H6/H4/H2/H1
why_new_for_mis: Positions low-pass filtering as an explicit pre-sensor that improves deep sequence models for FX closes.
quote: In algorithmic trading, the preference for low-pass filters stems from several key advantages: Signal Smoothing: Low-pass filters effectively smooth out noisy price movements, emphasizing longer-term trends over short-term fluctuations.

idea_name: Calendar-month seasonality concatenation for LSTM training
mechanism: Concatenate multi-year February (etc.) H1 slices into one CSV; train seasonal LSTM; compare optimization Sharpe density vs non-seasonal filtered model—seasonal model has fewer negative-Sharpe cells despite lower R2.
data_needed: multi-year same-calendar-month OHLC slices; autocorrelation of concatenated series
why_new_for_mis: Treats calendar-month slices as a seasonal regime corpus for neural sensing rather than continuous history.
quote: What I've found curious, is that the number of negative Sharpe values occupies half of the table from the optimization for the filtered model, while the negative ones for the seasonal model occupies around a fifth of the table.

idea_name: Online logit/probit on lagged bar returns with LR significance gate
mechanism: GetDataset builds lag_ standardized (Close-Open) features and next-bar up/down labels; FitLogitRegression maximizes NLL(+L2) via L-BFGS with SE/covariance; Trade_PredictedTarget only acted on if Likelihood-Ratio > Chi2crit (ModelSignificant); reoptimize every reoptimize_step bars.
data_needed: OHLC for feature and label symbols; InpCount history; lag_; alpha; C for L2
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD default; GBPUSD Daily backtest example
why_new_for_mis: Classical binary classifier as a live direction sensor gated by statistical model significance, not raw probability alone.
quote: this EA also includes a procedure for testing the model hypothesis for significance... If the calculated value of the LR statistic falls into the critical region, i.e. LR > X2crit (alpha; v=lag_), then H0 hypothesis is rejected, and therefore the trading signal is not ignored

idea_name: Open-close ratio slope and arctan angle as time-free price features
mechanism: Slope=(Close_t-Close_{t-h})/(Open_t-Open_{t-h}); Angle=arctan(Slope) to avoid weekend-time distortion of ΔP/Δt; used as KNN/ONNX inputs with OHLC; weak raw correlation but +20% KNN MSE improvement when combined.
data_needed: M1 OHLC (USDZAR 10k+ rows); look_ahead horizon; mean/std for ONNX scaling
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: USDZAR M1; D1 EMA confirmation on USDZAR and DXY; MACD on EURUSD in EA
why_new_for_mis: Replaces time-axis slope with open-sensitivity slope/angle as a deterministic geometric feature for neural sensors.
quote: We could instead calculate the slope formed by price by using the difference in opening price divided by the difference in close price. We have substituted time from the x-axis.

mechanism: ContextAnalyzer maintains short/medium/long/episodic/pattern memories; computes input_volatility, magnitude, complexity; dynamically reweights memories (short_weight rises with volatility; episodic/pattern with complexity); resonance/interference mixes contexts; episodic updates only when importance > 1.5× avg.
data_needed: feature matrix streams; context_size; symbol-adaptive base weights
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: architecture for FX/crypto (AdaptMemoryWeights BTC/ETH vs USD); Part I include file only
why_new_for_mis: Explicit multi-horizon memory sensor that adapts memory mix from live volatility/complexity, plus episodic gate for shock regimes.
quote: High volatility forces more attention to short-term memory. Complex patterns activate episodic and pattern memory. These are not hard and fast rules, but dynamic weights that adapt to the current market situation.

mechanism: Meta model takes original features, primary prediction, and error_metrics through tanh hidden layer → sigmoid confidence in [0,1] to down-weight overconfident forecasts.
data_needed: primary model outputs; rolling error metrics
why_new_for_mis: Secondary reliability sensor over a neural forecast—useful as MIS confidence channel.
quote: The meta model analyzes not only the initial data and forecast of the main model, but also the error history, current quality metrics, and market behavior patterns. It learns to recognize situations where the underlying model is prone to error, and accordingly reduces confidence in its predictions.
